name: herdr-commander
description: Inside herdr: Claude's own Agent (herdr worker types), SendMessage, TaskStop, ListAgents and Read go through herdr panes; commander pane, lifecycle, notifications via herdr-bridge. Outside herdr it does nothing

takeover.title: Claude's own tools go through herdr
takeover.description: Inside herdr: Agent (herdr worker types), SendMessage, TaskStop, ListAgents and Read of herdr files run through herdr panes, and the herdr_worker_spawn tool is added. Background commands, Monitor and other agent types always stay Claude's own. Off: all of them are Claude's own.

lifecycleReport.title: Report state to herdr
lifecycleReport.description: Report this pane's working/blocked/idle state to herdr (pane report-agent) instead of herdr reading the screen.

notifications.title: Commander notifications
notifications.description: As commander, notify (herdr notification + toast) when another agent becomes blocked or finishes.

pushNotificationMirror.title: Mirror PushNotification to herdr
pushNotificationMirror.description: Also show PushNotification as a herdr notification.

deliverFlow.title: /deliver through herdr
deliverFlow.description: When the deliver skill runs inside herdr, add the herdr-pane flavour of the pipeline.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the agent list is refreshed (2-60). One herdr call takes about a second.
